## Security, legal and compliance summary

Our SOC 2 Type II report was issued in March 2026 by an independent auditor.

- **Uptime (trailing 90 days)**: 99.67%
- **Severity-1 incidents (last 12 months)**: 1
There is no pending or threatened litigation against the Company.

All current and former employees and contractors have signed IP assignment agreements.

Data processing agreements are signed with all customers that require one.

Open-source licences were reviewed by counsel in 2026.

The Company has no D&O insurance.

A 409A valuation was completed within the last 12 months.

All federal and state taxes are filed and paid.
